# Handover checklist

Completed by the squad, not by the CoE engineer. The embed ends when every item is checked or has a named
owner and date.

## The squad can, without help

- [ ] Change the prompt, bump its version, re-record and get the evaluation gate green.
- [ ] Add a failing live case to the evaluation set and explain why it failed.
- [ ] Read a trace for a slow or failed request and say where the time or the error came from.
- [ ] Answer "what did this cost last week" from the dashboard.
- [ ] Switch the model or the fallback and compare the evaluation reports before and after.

## The squad owns

- [ ] Repository, CI and deployment pipeline.
- [ ] Evaluation set and thresholds, with the business owner named.
- [ ] Runbook and on-call rota.
- [ ] Asset registry entry, with maturity level and next review date.

## Signed off

| Role | Name | Date |
|---|---|---|
| Squad lead | | |
| Business owner | | |
| CoE engineer | | |
